index.title: Wallpaper Installer London Areas | Mr Wallcover
index.description: Wallpaper and wallcovering installation in Mayfair, Belgravia, Chelsea, Kensington, the City of London and the Cotswolds. Survey, supply, hang and aftercare.
index.heading: London and the surrounding areas.
index.lede: We cover London and the surrounding areas, and work UK-wide for selected projects. These are the areas we are asked about most. The method is the same in each: a survey, a written scope by room, the same core team, and a return visit once the paper has settled.

items.name: Mayfair
items.title: Wallpaper Installer in Mayfair | Mr Wallcover
items.description: Wallpaper and wallcovering installation in Mayfair, W1. Main decorating contractor at Brown's Hotel, 2022–2024. Survey, supply, hang and aftercare.
items.heading: Wallpaper installation in Mayfair
items.lede: Hotels, townhouses and apartments in Mayfair, W1. Our longest recent commission in the area was Brown's Hotel on Albemarle Street, where Mr Wallcover was the main decorating contractor from 2022 to 2024.
paragraphs: Mayfair rooms tend to carry expensive materials: hand-painted scenic papers, silk, grasscloth and fabric walling. They are also rooms that stay in use while the work goes on, whether that is a hotel floor with guests or a house with a household.

At Brown's Hotel the package was wallcoverings, fine painting, French polishing and other specialist finishes, carried out room by room around a working hotel. The same approach applies to a single drawing room: a contained work area, protection of floors and joinery, and a tidy room at the end of each day.

We survey on site, write the scope room by room, and quantify the paper with the repeat and the wastage it needs. If the paper is supplied by your designer, we receive it, check it against the measure, and hang what was specified.

faq.question: Do you work in occupied houses and hotels in Mayfair?
paragraphs: Yes. Most of our Mayfair work has been in rooms that stay in use. At Brown's Hotel the decorating package ran from 2022 to 2024 around a working hotel. Work areas are contained and left tidy each day.

faq.question: How do you price wallpaper hanging in Mayfair?
paragraphs: From a site survey or from drawings. The figure follows the measured area after openings are taken off, the pattern repeat, the state of the walls and the material. There is no flat rate per roll.

items.name: Belgravia
items.title: Wallpaper Installer in Belgravia | Mr Wallcover
items.description: Wallpaper and wallcovering installation in Belgravia and Knightsbridge, SW1. Silk, grasscloth, fabric walling and hand-painted papers, with aftercare included.
items.heading: Wallpaper installation in Belgravia
items.lede: Stucco townhouses, mansion flats and hotels in Belgravia and Knightsbridge, SW1. We survey, supply where asked, hang, and return once the paper has settled.
paragraphs: Belgravia houses often have tall rooms, deep cornices and original joinery. That means long drops, careful set-out from a fixed point, and protection of the plasterwork and woodwork that is already there.
Private clients are not named. Residential work appears only by street or area, with the owner's agreement. If you would like to see comparable rooms, ask, and we will arrange what discretion allows.

faq.question: Can you hang wallpaper in a listed Belgravia townhouse?
paragraphs: Yes. We follow the specification and whatever the consents for the building allow. If a wall is not ready for the material, we say so at the survey, before the paper is ordered.

faq.question: Do you work with interior designers in Belgravia?
paragraphs: Yes. Paper is usually free-issue from the designer or the client. We manage delivery, check the quantities against our measure, and hang to the designer's specification.

items.name: Chelsea
items.title: Wallpaper Installer in Chelsea | Mr Wallcover
items.description: Wallpaper installation in Chelsea, SW3 and SW10. Hand-painted papers, grasscloth, silk and murals, hung by a London practice. Aftercare included.
items.heading: Wallpaper installation in Chelsea
items.lede: Houses and apartments in Chelsea, SW3 and SW10. Hand-painted papers, grasscloth, silk, fabric walling and murals, from the survey to the return visit.
paragraphs: Chelsea work is mostly private houses, and we do not name them. What carries across from our hotel work is the method: a written scope by room, the same core team throughout, and a contained, tidy work area in a house that is still lived in.

Preparation is part of the scope where it is specified: stripping old paper, sanding with dust extraction, and making good before anything decorative goes up. Some papers are hung over a lining. Some, including certain murals, are specified without one.
Aftercare is included. About four to six weeks after completion we come back to check seams, edges and corners once the paper has settled, and the workmanship carries a twelve-month guarantee.

faq.question: Will you take on a single room in Chelsea?
paragraphs: Yes. A single room in a private house can often be scheduled sooner than a hotel package. We give a date after the survey.

faq.question: What happens after the paper is hung?
paragraphs: We return about four to six weeks after completion, at no call-out charge, to look at seams, edges and corners. The workmanship guarantee lasts twelve months from completion.

items.name: Kensington
items.title: Wallpaper Installer in Kensington | Mr Wallcover
items.description: Wallpaper and wallcovering installation in Kensington and Holland Park, W8 and W11. Survey, supply, hang and aftercare from a London practice.
items.heading: Wallpaper installation in Kensington
items.lede: Townhouses, mansion flats and family houses in Kensington and Holland Park. Surveying, supply, installation and aftercare from one London practice.
paragraphs: Kensington houses range from Victorian stucco to later mansion blocks, and the walls vary as much as the architecture. The survey is a judgement on the wall as well as a measure of it. If the wall is not ready for the material specified, we say so before the last drop is ordered.

We hang silk, grasscloth and other natural weaves, fabric walling, vinyl, hand-painted papers in the manner of de Gournay and Fromental, murals and acoustic wallcoverings. Paper can be hung to joinery where the drawings show it.
Private clients are not named. Residential work appears only by street or area, with the owner's agreement. The public record of our work is on the projects page.

faq.question: Which wallcoverings do you hang in Kensington homes?
paragraphs: Silk, grasscloth and natural weaves, fabric walling, vinyl and contract wallcoverings, hand-painted papers, murals, and acoustic wallcoverings and panels.

faq.question: How much extra wallpaper should I order?
paragraphs: Enough to cover the pattern repeat and the wastage it creates. Where the repeat is demanding, that allowance is often in the region of 20%. We quantify it from the survey.

items.name: the City of London
items.title: Wallcovering Installer, City of London | Mr Wallcover
items.description: Hotel and commercial wallcovering installation in the City of London: Four Seasons Ten Trinity Square and The Old Bailey Hotel. Aftercare included.
items.heading: Wallcovering installation in the City of London
items.lede: Hotels and commercial interiors in the Square Mile. In the City, Mr Wallcover carried out the guest room and suite wallpapering at Four Seasons Hotel London at Ten Trinity Square from 2016 to 2019, and was the main decorating contractor at the hotel at 15 Old Bailey.
paragraphs: City projects run to programmes set by the main contractor and the building. Our role is usually a package within that programme: survey, quantities, delivery of free-issue goods, the hang, and the snagging that follows.
On a longer commission, a project leader is on site every day and senior oversight agrees a forward plan with the site team each week. Frequent, plain communication is part of the method.
Contract wallcoverings, vinyls and acoustic finishes are common in City hotels and offices. We also hang the natural weaves and specialist papers that appear in suites and front-of-house areas.

faq.question: Do you work alongside main contractors?
paragraphs: Yes. We work alongside main contractors on City programmes, taking the full wallcovering or decorating package and fitting in with the site team, the programme and the building's rules. We can also run the package directly for the client. At Ten Trinity Square the guest room and suite wallpapering ran from 2016 to 2019.

faq.question: Can you work to a hotel or fit-out programme?
paragraphs: Yes. Delivery is timed to the hang and the work moves floor by floor or room by room to suit the programme. Free-issue goods are checked against the measure on arrival.

items.name: the Cotswolds
items.title: Wallpaper Installer for the Cotswolds | Mr Wallcover
items.description: London wallpaper installers for country houses in the Cotswolds. Hand-painted papers, grasscloth, silk and fabric walling, with survey, supply and aftercare.
items.heading: Wallpaper installation in the Cotswolds
items.lede: Country houses and estates in the Cotswolds and beyond. Mr Wallcover is a London practice, and for the right project the same core team travels to the house.
paragraphs: Country houses bring their own conditions: old lime plaster, uneven walls, tall stair halls and rooms that were not built square. The survey covers the state of the walls as well as the measure, so the preparation is in the scope from the start.
Hand-painted and scenic papers, grasscloth, silk and fabric walling are set out from a fixed point so the pattern meets where it should, around doors, chimney breasts and corners.

The aftercare is the same as in London: a return visit about four to six weeks after completion, and a twelve-month guarantee on the workmanship. Outside London, the public record of our work also includes Hilton Silverstone.

faq.question: Do you travel outside London for wallpaper installation?
paragraphs: Yes. We cover London and the surrounding areas, and work UK-wide for selected projects, including country houses in the Cotswolds.

faq.question: Can you hang wallpaper on old or uneven walls?
paragraphs: Often, with the right preparation. The survey is a judgement on the wall. If it is not ready for the material specified, we say so and write the preparation into the scope before anyone orders the paper.
